title: The existence conjecture for $p$-adic Asai $L$-functions
statement:
Let $F$ be the CM field, let $p$ be a prime, let $\boldsymbol{\rm As}^+_{\mathcal M}(\pi)$ denote the positive Asai motive attached to $\pi$, and let $\mathcal O_\pi$ be the coefficient ring. Write $F(\mu_{p^\infty})$ for the extension obtained by adjoining all $p$-power roots of unity. For a Hecke character $\phi:F^\times\backslash F^\times_{\mathbf A}\to\mathbf C^\times$, let $\widehat\phi$ denote its associated character of $\operatorname{Gal}(F(\mu_{p^\infty})/F)$, and let $\mathcal E_p$ and $\mathcal E_\infty$ be the local interpolation factors. Let $\Omega(\boldsymbol{\rm As}^+_{\mathcal M}(\pi))$ be the period appearing in the critical-value formula.

**The existence conjecture for $p$-adic Asai $L$-functions.** There exists an element

$$
\mathscr L_p(\boldsymbol{\rm As}^+_{\mathcal M}(\pi))\in\mathcal O_\pi[[\operatorname{Gal}(F(\mu_{p^\infty})/F)]]
$$

such that, for every Hecke character $\phi$ satisfying

$$
\phi_\infty(x)=x^{n-\alpha}\quad\text{for some }0\leq\alpha\leq n,
$$

with $\phi$ of $p$-power conductor and $\boldsymbol{\rm As}^+_{\mathcal M}(\pi)(\phi)$ critical at $s=0$, one has

$$
\widehat\phi(\mathscr L_p(\boldsymbol{\rm As}^+_{\mathcal M}(\pi)))=\mathcal E_\infty(\boldsymbol{\rm As}^+_{\mathcal M}(\pi)(\phi))\mathcal E_p(\boldsymbol{\rm As}^+_{\mathcal M}(\pi)(\phi))\frac{L(0,\boldsymbol{\rm As}^+_{\mathcal M}(\pi)(\phi))}{\Omega(\boldsymbol{\rm As}^+_{\mathcal M}(\pi))}.
$$

This conjecture predicts a $p$-adic interpolation of critical Asai $L$-values; the supplied text does not establish the asserted existence in general.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1912.07251

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of December 2019).
source_name: Kenichi Namikawa, “A construction of p-adic Asai L-functions for GL_2 over CM fields”, arXiv:1912.07251 (2019).
